source_issue.title: Metadata block or easy way to insert document metadata inside text block

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue proposes adding a new feature to the Plone Volto editor, allowing users to easily insert document metadata (like publishing date or tags) within text blocks. This enhancement aims to facilitate the creation of dynamic pages by enabling the integration of metadata content seamlessly.

## What needs to be done
A new block type or button should be developed that allows users to display metadata anywhere in the content area. Discussions suggest that integrating this feature into the core of Volto would provide significant benefits for managing page-specific metadata.

## Helpful background
The idea is based on current use cases where displaying context or subjects within content is crucial. There are existing add-ons that provide related functionalities, but there is a conversation about the merits of including this feature directly in Volto's core.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the existing add-ons mentioned, particularly [volto-metadata-block](https://github.com/eea/volto-metadata-block) and [volto-slate-metadata-mentions](https://github.com/eea/volto-slate-metadata-mentions).
2. Review the current structure of text blocks in Volto to understand where this feature could fit in.
3. Join the discussion on GitHub to share your thoughts or ask questions about implementation specifics.
4. After initial research, consider prototyping a simple version of the feature to gather feedback.
```
